snippet.title: GetHigh.EXE – Hardcore Parkour Inspired by Call of Duty’s Get High & Get Higher | Official Gameplay
snippet.description:
#GetHighEXE #GetHigh #GetHigher
👉 Play in browser: https://zypong.itch.io/

---

👉 🎮 Play or Wishlist GetHigh.EXE on *Steam* Store – Try the Demo!:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4331890/GetHighEXE/

👉 🎮 Play or Wishlist GetHigh.EXE on *Epic Games* Store – Try the Demo!: 
https://store.epicgames.com/p/gethighexe-c83d1f

---

🔥GetHigh.EXE Demo version live stream gameplay by TSG 7 😎:
https://www.youtube.com/live/JFoGKPwEU4U?t=371s

---

6 out of 10 players could finish the game during our beta testing, so we're excited to see how you do!

---

If you loved Call of Duty: Get High and Get Higher, but want a harder, faster, standalone experience, this is for you.

GetHigh.EXE is a first-person parkour challenge platformer/platform game inspired by the iconic Call of Duty movement maps platform-style challenges — but pushed to the extreme. Precision jumps, mid-air control, tight timings, and nonstop vertical climbing. No guns. No distractions. Just pure movement mastery.

Tired of watching other people’s gameplay clips?
Stop watching. Start playing. Finish something.

---

🚀 What is GetHigh.EXE?

* First-person platformer
* Extreme arcade-style parkour
* Inspired by COD Get High / Get Higher
* About 350 meters of vertical climbing, just like the original gethigh maps
* Precise movement, speedrunning, and timing
* Synthwave / neon retro-futuristic visuals
* Moving platforms, rotating obstacles, brutal jumps
* Optional checkpoints for practice & mastery
* Hidden Secret Cookies for explorers
* Built for YouTube, TikTok, livestreams & speedrun clips

Every fall hurts. Every checkpoint matters.
Can you reach the top?

---

🧠 For Call of Duty Players

Many Call of Duty players are frustrated lately.

GetHigh.EXE is about focus, skill, and completion:

* One course
* One goal
* One finish

Just you vs the climb.

---

🔴 Use external recording tools to capture your GetHigh.EXE gameplay and showcase your runs to the world.

This game rewards mastery, not luck.

---

🎮 Platforms & Controls

* Single-player
* Keyboard & Mouse
* Controller support
* PC (Steam & Epic Games)

---

🔔 Wishlist & Support

If you enjoy:

* Call of Duty movement maps
* Get High / Get Higher
* Parkour games
* Skill-based challenges
* Speedrunning

👉 🎮 Play or Wishlist GetHigh.EXE on *Steam* Store – Try the Demo!:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4331890/GetHighEXE/

👉 🎮 Play or Wishlist GetHigh.EXE on *Epic Games* Store – Try the Demo!: 
https://store.epicgames.com/p/gethighexe-c83d1f

---

Website:
https://www.Zypong.com/

---

⚠ Disclaimer

GetHigh.EXE is not affiliated with Activision or Call of Duty.
It is an independent game inspired by classic movement challenges.
